name: @vssaros/dsh-superagent
description: VsSaros built-in: SuperAgent, the supervisor of the VsSaros Bots. It takes requests from Feishu, GitHub, TAPD and its own desk, evaluates them under a Policy, staffs a team of Bots that a person agrees to, runs each step in its Bot's Session, and leaves skills and team workflows behind. Source, tests and build tools are in dev/ (not shipped).

workbench.title: SuperAgent
workbench.description: SuperAgent 主管：接收飞书、GitHub、TAPD 和主管对话里的需求，评估后组建 bot 团队，经你同意再分工执行，并沉淀技能。

vssarosPatches.layout: Upstream root files map to dev/ (src, tests, docs, examples, scripts, SETUP.md, configs, package.json); prompts, skills, locale, cordis.patch.yml, README.md, NOTICE and LICENSE stay at the plugin root. dev/scripts/upstream-patches.mjs writes and checks the patch set.
